answer: I would stop farms with device integrity verdict from Play Integrity API, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. A farm running 754 aliases would need 754 separate proofs, each costing about 89 POA or 15 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The nadir test is the live device, the canyon test is the locked stake, and the gale test is the graded history no template can fake. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
